text: The Unkindled, also called Ashen Ones, are tasked with hunting down and slaying the Lords of Cinder and forcibly returning their cinders to their thrones at Firelink Shrine, opening the path to the Kiln of the First Flame.
The Ashen One uses the coiled sword to light the first bonfire in the Cemetery of Ash, opening the path to Firelink Shrine.
The Fire Keeper channels souls gathered by the Ashen One into power to help them grow stronger.
Ludleth of Courland acts as a transposer who can reshape the souls of powerful beings into weapons, shields, and spells using the Transposing Kiln.
Lothric of Carim teaches the Ashen One the skill of transposing souls, allowing them to forge weapons and miracles from boss souls.
Defeating Vordt of the Boreal Valley opens the gate leading from the High Wall of Lothric to the Undead Settlement.
Three great flame beacons stand in the Farron swamp, representing the Undead Legion's vigilance; relighting them in an old ritual of Farron opens the path to Farron Keep.
A magic barrier blocked Irithyll of the Boreal Valley until the Ashen One used the small doll obtained from the Deacons of the Deep.
The Storm Ruler greatsword can unleash gusts of thunderous wind capable of staggering Yhorm the Giant, who is otherwise resistant to conventional weapons.
The Dancer of the Boreal Valley alternates between slow, elegant attacks and a wild spinning spiral attack that sets the floor ablaze.
Placing the Basin of Vows on the altar statue in the chapel activated a hidden mechanism, lowering a ladder up into Lothric Castle.
The Ashen One killed one wyvern in Lothric Castle by leaping from higher ground and stabbing it through the skull.
The second wyvern in Lothric Castle was controlled by a parasitic pilgrim insect; killing the insect caused the wyvern to stop moving.
Pools of melted wax in the Grand Archives can be used to coat the head, creating a protective barrier against the cursed spirits inhabiting the books.
The Ashen One returns to Firelink Shrine and places the cinders of the Abyss Watchers, Aldrich, Yhorm, and Lothric upon four empty thrones.
The Firekeeper instructs the Ashen One to kneel before the bonfire and coiled sword at Firelink Shrine so the five seated lords can witness and acknowledge the Ashen One as their heir.
Power from the five occupied thrones surges into the bonfire, creating a vortex that transports the Ashen One and the Firekeeper from Firelink Shrine to the Kiln of the First Flame.
The Painted World of Ariandel is meant to periodically burn away in a cleansing flame and be repainted anew, but this cycle has been deliberately stopped, causing the realm to rot.
A transitory symbol appears to the Ashen One after defeating the Soul of Cinder, guiding them toward the Ringed City via the Dreg Heap.
When the Ashen One touches and crumbles Filianore's egg, time unravels and reality shifts forward into the far future.
Undead who die repeatedly gradually lose their minds and memories, eventually becoming mindless Hollows.
Successful champions who linked the flame became Lords of Cinder, their bodies burned to ash while their souls fueled the flame for another age.
Champions who failed to become Lords of Cinder became Unkindled, ash lacking even the strength to be proper kindling.
Yoel of Londor offers the Ashen One free levels in exchange for accepting Dark Sigils, marks of the hollowing curse, until he dies after granting five levels and five sigils.
